title: fix: report pod states in lowercase for consistency
body:
### Description

This PR updates the pod state string definitions in `libpod/define/podstate.go` to use lowercase formats (e.g., `" created "` instead of `" Created "`, `" error "` instead of `" Error "`). This ensures that the state output for Pods is consistent with the formatting used for Containers. 

The End-to-End (e2e) tests in `test/e2e/pod_create_test.go` have been updated to assert against these new lowercase state strings.

Fixes: #19097
